items.idiom: get the wrong end of the stick
items.example: I didn't mean that — you got the wrong end of the stick.
items.mnemonic: Стик не тем концом схватил: get the wrong end of the stick — неправильно понять мои слова.

items.example: When she told me the news, I was completely lost for words.
items.mnemonic: Лост от новости: lost for words — потерять дар речи, когда она рассказала.

items.idiom: not make head nor tail of something
items.example: I can't make head nor tail of these instructions.
items.mnemonic: Ни хед, ни тейл неясны: not make head nor tail of something — не понять ничего в инструкции.
